## A Legend Among Legends

There comes a point where the newspapers stop printing your bounty and start printing your legend.

Reach 47,500 Doriki to open the weekly endgame contracts.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [The Road Poneglyphs](05_new_world.md#q-74c0704c257d8552)

**Tasks**

- Reach 47,500 Doriki

**Rewards**

- Belly +150,000, +2 Training Points (your style)

<a id="q-79da67cf47084a4e"></a>

## Hot Zone War

Every week one island becomes the centre of the world. Everybody goes there, and everybody fights. Use /voyage hotzone to see which island it is this week.

Defeat thirty fighters or players on this week's hot zone island.

Repeats every week (Monday 06:00 UTC). Doriki over the cap is paid out as Belly instead.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [A Legend Among Legends](endgame.md#q-301215cf95785a32)

**Tasks**

- Defeat 30 fighters or players on the hot zone island

**Rewards**

- Doriki +1,200, Belly +120,000, Haki +10 Busoshoku / +10 Kenbunshoku, Legendary Crate (scales with Doriki)

<a id="q-1320c7bd14e9e719"></a>

## Laugh Tale Expedition

The guardian of the final island returns if somebody calls it back. Bring a crew.

Be in the End, within 256 blocks, when the Ender Dragon dies this week.

Repeats every week (Monday 06:00 UTC). Doriki over the cap is paid out as Belly instead.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [A Legend Among Legends](endgame.md#q-301215cf95785a32)

**Tasks**

- Take part in an Ender Dragon kill this week

**Rewards**

- Doriki +1,500, Belly +200,000, Haki +15 Busoshoku / +15 Kenbunshoku, Legendary Crate (scales with Doriki)

## The God Valley Incident

Thirty-eight years ago, Roger and Garp fought side by side against the Rocks Pirates, and an island vanished from the map.

Reach 50,000 Doriki. The server must win 500 battles on God Valley, and you must land 50 yourself.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [A Legend Among Legends](endgame.md#q-301215cf95785a32)

**Tasks**

- Reach 50,000 Doriki
- Land on God Valley
- Server: 500 battles won on God Valley (50 yours)

**Rewards**

- Belly +500,000, Haki +15 Busoshoku / +15 Kenbunshoku, +2 Training Points (your style), Golden Box
